summary: Stage 2 closeout tested through the preview URL. Backend: 174/174 unit tests and 22/22 existing live tests pass, plus 7/7 in the new tests_live/test_stage2_closeout_live.py. That file covers the /api/metadata/status shape, demo-library isolation, Northern Survey runtimes (40/35 s, never played), runtime_status, a fast rescan, the required client header, and a temporary TEST_ library whose length was filled in by the background reader after the scan. Pending UI: I added a temporary 240-episode TEST library. Right after the scan, 196 cards showed 'Reading length…' (episode-runtime-pending-*). The page quietly refetched every ~4 s and everything resolved to '40 s' within ~10 s. Focus stayed on the selected episode throughout. The library was then removed. Frontend checks at 1920x1080 all pass: Home (tabs to strip, Stage Details then Back restores focus to stage-details-action, card then Back restores focus to the card, monogram cards show the title once), movie detail (Resume/Start over/progress), show detail (data-state unwatched/partial/watched, '40 s' runtimes, Left/Right, Up to the selected season tab, Down to the previous episode, PageUp/PageDown, season switching), and the player (osd/hidden/expanded modes, Enter toggles, Left/Right seek ±10 s on the surface, Up expands with focus on play/pause, expanded arrows move focus only, seek bar arrows seek, Esc collapses then exits with focus restored, OSD hides after ~4 s while playing and stays while paused, resume from 0:54/0:20, Next episode). Scaling: 3840x2160 at DPR 1 gives data-ui-scale=2. An earlier run was capped at 3840x1920 and gave 1.78 (= min rule). 1920x1080 at DPR 2 gives 1. 2560x1440 gives 1.33. Home, movie, show, Movies and TV pages have no page overflow at any size; Settings scrolls vertically, as expected. At 4K, keyboard navigation and Episode Journey centering work, and clicking the seek bar lands exactly at 25/50/75% (22.5/45/67.5 s). Reduced motion: transitions are 0s and the flash mark is static (animation none) and then removed; navigation still works. Simulated gamepad (stubbed getGamepads): D-pad, LB/RB, A to play and B to go back with focus restored all work. No console errors. Only simulated, not verified on a physical Xbox, Windows TV or 4K TV.

minor.issue: Code review, not reproduced: files the worker put in _skipped (offline NAS, timeout) still have probe_json NULL, so they keep reporting runtime_status='pending'. The UI would show 'Reading length…' forever, and ShowDetail's quiet refresh would poll every 4 s indefinitely until the next rescan or restart. Suggest reporting 'unknown' (or a separate 'unreachable' status) for ids in DurationWorker._skipped.

ui_bugs.issue: On direct page load or after mouse input, the focused primary button has NO visible focus ring. In detail/detail.css, '.dt-primary { box-shadow: 0 10px 40px ... }' has the same specificity as ':focus-visible' in styles.css and loads later, so it overrides the ring. The ring only appears once body[data-input=keys] is set by a key press. Reproduced at 1080p, 1440p and 4K. Fix: add '.dt-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: var(--focus), 0 10px 40px rgba(135,232,208,.18); }'.

issues: The Stage chip says '1 min left' for Sample Movie, while the movie detail says '36 s left' for the same progress (54/90 s). The rounding is inconsistent.
A watched card without a thumbnail shows the code twice: 'S01E03' as the monogram and 'S01E03' in the label (innerText 'S01E03 / Watched / S01E03'). Acceptable but redundant.
Down from the primary action lands on the season tab when the series has no progress, but on the episode card when there is a next-up/resume. Possibly intended; worth confirming.
Gamepad/Right from the last season tab (season-tab-2) drops into the episode strip (episode-card-7) instead of staying on the tab row. Minor.
After clicking Next episode with the mouse, the mode is 'expanded' but focus is on the player surface rather than a control. The next arrow press refocuses play/pause, so this is harmless.

action_items: Restore the visible focus ring on .dt-primary (detail/detail.css box-shadow overrides :focus-visible) for initial and mouse-then-keyboard focus
Report runtime_status 'unknown' for files the DurationWorker has marked unreachable (_skipped), so the UI doesn't show 'Reading length…' and poll every 4 s forever
Optional: make the remaining-time rounding consistent between the Home Stage chip ('1 min left') and the detail page ('36 s left')
critical_code_review_comments: durations.py: _claim runs SQL (_next) while holding self._cond, so prioritize()/status()/wake() callers on request threads block behind the worker's DB query. Fine for SQLite on local disk; consider querying outside the lock.

durations.py _next fallback: 'LIMIT len(excluded)+1' grows with the skipped set. On a large unreachable NAS, every claim scans that many rows. Acceptable, but a 'WHERE id NOT IN (...)' or a cursor offset would be cleaner.

routes_library._runtime falls back to the player-reported progress.duration when there's no probe data. This is good, but a stale duration from a since-replaced file could show until the file is reprobed (the probe is reset on size/mtime change, so low risk).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 medium focus-ring bug, minor design notes)

Playwright viewport 3840x2160 was sometimes capped to 3840x1920 by the tool. /play/<id> without ?start shows the resume prompt when progress exists.
rca of the issue: Focus ring: styles.css line 72 ':focus-visible { box-shadow: var(--focus) }' (specificity 0,1,0) is overridden by detail/detail.css line 37-38 '.dt-primary { box-shadow: 0 10px 40px ... }' (0,1,0, later in cascade). 'body[data-input=keys] :focus' (0,2,1) wins only after a keydown sets data-input, so a first-load or mouse-then-keyboard user sees no ring on the autofocused primary action.
